column1: # G5 census of direct coordinated database writes (git-canonical plan, wave G5).
# `withCoordinatedWrite` / `coordinatedDatabaseWrite` commit rows with no file and no receipt. Every call site needs a row;
# test/coordinated-write-census.test.ts enforces it. Authored memory content has no class: it goes through the page-mutation door.

column5: reason

column1: # class: door (the page-mutation door's own publication), projection (rebuilt from committed markdown),
#        operational (source, sync and retention bookkeeping), metadata (trust tier beside a row),
#        removal (deletes rows only, moving the database toward git), generated (producer output its producer regenerates),
#        facts_lane (facts, withdrawals and ontology rows; G4 gives them a file form).

column5: Rebuilds page_aliases from each page's frontmatter aliases and mention policy; the committed page text is the input, so the indexer reproduces every row.
Deletes the verify probe's fence facts after the probe page and its file were purged through the door; it only removes rows whose file is already gone.
Concept-provenance edges are the synthesis output bound to the concept page revision; the next synthesis regenerates them. G6 moves concept publication through the door.

Only trust metadata runs here: the derived-tier lowering of an extract_entities page and of an unknown-tier timeline row. The stub, the timeline bullet and its backlink (the bullet's derived markdown edge) are door mutations of the entity page.
purge_fact physical erasure waits on the G4 product ruling (erasure versus git history, GBRA-190); until then it stays a database write paired with its mirror commit.
Mention-pass alias and mention-edge rows are derived from committed page text; a re-run of the pass over the same tree reproduces them.
ontology_propose observations are database-only until G4 (GBRA-190) gives ontology observations a page home.
Segment texts, manifest rows and sweeps are the stored form of a page body the door already published; they are rebuilt from that body.
Materializes the withdrawal overlay into the stored body; G4 (GBRA-190) turns forget into fence edits and retires the withdrawal mirror.
Clears a connector source's stale local_path pointer, or any source's relative one, on the sources row; source configuration, not memory content.
Stamps last_sync_at/newest_content_at freshness on the sources row for a skipped checkpoint save; sync bookkeeping, not memory content.
The page-mutation door itself: the prepared publication and its after-effects commit here after the file is in place.
Group publication of door requests: the same prepared publications as publishMutation, committed as one group.
Re-derives markdown, frontmatter and mention edges from each page's current text, bound to the revision it read; the indexer reproduces them.
forget/forget_fact withdrawals; G4 (GBRA-190) makes them fence edits and derives the withdrawal ledger on import.
Source topology changes (remove, purge, archive) on the sources and binding rows; source administration, not memory content.
An idle sync pass stamps last_sync_at and its pass row; sync bookkeeping, not memory content.
An unchanged sync pass stamps last_sync_at and its converged watermark; sync bookkeeping, not memory content.
A sync that found nothing stamps the freshness heartbeat and releases holds for paths that left the source; sync bookkeeping, not memory content.
Finishes a recorded source topology clone under its native lock; source administration, not memory content.
Deletes alias and redirect rows whose target page has no row at all; the page is gone from git too, so the delete only brings the database to git.
The pre-#6023 consolidation writeback closed these facts in the database only, never in the fence; reopening them makes each row equal what its fence row imports to.
Retires duplicate database-only facts; fenced copies are struck through the fence. Unfenced facts move into fences in G4 (GBRA-190).
Moves database-only facts of a page-less entity; G4 (GBRA-190) gives unfenced facts a fence home.
Strips parser-reserved keys older imports stored in pages.frontmatter; they never render, so the stripped row equals what the file parses to.
Restores ontology-observation facts; G4 (GBRA-190) gives ontology observations a page home.
Admits a journaled re-mirror request and queues its withdrawal-mirror and Git effects, which rewrite the canonical file.
Rewrites or deletes timeline rows still carrying markup so they equal the tuple the parser reads from the page text.
Prunes retained shared-skill revisions inside a skill-bundle publication; retention bookkeeping, the bundle files are published separately.
Prunes retained shared-skill revisions past the retention limits; retention bookkeeping, not memory content.
Retracts timeline rows the page text no longer supports, against the text read in the same transaction; the indexer reproduces the result.
Lowers trust tiers a claim lifted and propagates the lowering; trust tier is metadata beside the row, never content of record.
Backfills trust tiers computed from page rules; trust tier is metadata beside the row, never content of record.
An accepted held removal re-derives the take from its fence row or the timeline row from the page body; the rows follow the text.

A released held fact with no entity slug, or whose entity page is missing, is inserted database-only (G4, GBRA-190, owns that class); every other managed fact release publishes its fence row through the door as a journaled trust_release request (trust/release-publish.ts).
An owner trust decision sets trust_tier and its owner_decision note on a fact, take or page row; trust tier is metadata, page content changes go through trust_owner_page.
